collaboration.introTitle: Let an AI agent help you edit
collaboration.introBody: Turn on Agent Session and an AI agent can work on this project with you — adding clips, arranging the timeline, and rendering videos.
collaboration.helpLine1: When it's on, an AI agent on this computer can connect to ReelTerminal and help you edit the current project. Its changes land in the same undo history as yours, so you can always undo them.
collaboration.helpLine2: Create or open a project first — the agent can only work on the project you have open.
collaboration.helpLine3: Footage the agent uses and videos it renders are kept in the Agent Workspace folder on this computer.

setup.title: Connect an Agent

setup.sessionReady: Agent Session is ready. ReelTerminal will still enforce work mode, approvals, and revision checks.

setup.authReady: A usable Codex account is signed in.
